sahneler.metin: A Metro-North commuter train struck an SUV at a crossing near Valhalla, New York.
Fire broke out, and six people were killed.
The SUV was caught as the gates came down.
The driver moved forward onto the tracks.
The collision tore up the electrified third rail.
The damaged rail led to a fire in the first car.

aciklama:
Valhalla saw a commuter train hit an SUV at a crossing. The cause: a collision that tore up the electrified third rail, which fed a fire in the lead car.
